purpose: The three asymmetric image arrangements inside the .ai section. Not a grid component with a column count - each is a hand-placed set of named slots.

two-up-with-arrow.detail: a source card and a result screen separated by a 1.5rem arrow glyph at text.faint; BOTH slots are theme pairs, so 4 elements for 2 visible images.

mobile-six-tile.detail: three columns (side / md / side), two tiles each, from the grid-mob-01..06 files. NOT theme-paired.

five-image-collage.detail: left, a nested collage of three, and right. Every slot has an -upd cross-fade twin carrying .is-img-anima-1..5, so 10 elements for 5 visible images.

three-video-collage.detail: the same .ai__grid-small skeleton filled with three component.background-video blocks instead of images.

responsive.base: the .ai__grid two-up is shown and .ai__grid-alt is hidden
responsive.max-767px: the two-up is hidden and the six-tile .ai__grid-alt collage is shown instead - a different element set rather than a reflow
